title_sv: Publicerad i Europeiska unionens officiella tidning
description_en: REGULATION (EU) 2024/1689 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence and amending Regulations (EC) No 300/2008, (EU) No 167/2013, (EU) No 168/2013, (EU) 2018/858, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2019/2144 and Directives 2014/90/EU, (EU) 2016/797 and (EU) 2020/1828 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
description_sv: REGULATION (EU) 2024/1689 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence and amending Regulations (EC) No 300/2008, (EU) No 167/2013, (EU) No 168/2013, (EU) 2018/858, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2019/2144 and Directives 2014/90/EU, (EU) 2016/797 and (EU) 2020/1828 (Artificial Intelligence Act)

title_en: The AI Act enters into force
description_en: Twenty days after publication in the Official Journal on 12 July 2024. Nothing applies yet.
description_sv: Tjugo dagar efter publiceringen i EUT den 12 juli 2024. Inget gäller ännu.
source_quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.

description_en: Chapters I and II: general provisions, AI literacy (Article 4) and the prohibited practices (Article 5).
description_sv: Kapitel I och II: allmänna bestämmelser, AI-kunnighet (artikel 4) och de förbjudna metoderna (artikel 5).
source_quote: Chapters I and II shall apply from 2 February 2025

title_en: General-purpose AI, governance and penalties apply
title_sv: Regler för AI för allmänna ändamål, styrning och sanktioner börjar gälla
description_en: Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models, notified bodies, the governance structure and penalties (except fines on GPAI providers).
description_sv: Skyldigheter för leverantörer av AI-modeller för allmänna ändamål, anmälda organ, styrningen och sanktionerna (utom böter för GPAI-leverantörer).
source_quote: Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII and Chapter XII and Article 78 shall apply from 2 August 2025

title_en: Deadline: Commission guidelines on high-risk classification
title_sv: Sista dag: kommissionens riktlinjer om högriskklassning
description_en: The Commission is to provide guidelines on Article 6 with practical examples of high-risk and non-high-risk use cases.
description_sv: Kommissionen ska ta fram riktlinjer om artikel 6 med praktiska exempel på användning som är och inte är högrisk.
source_quote: no later than 2 February 2026, provide guidelines specifying the practical implementation of this Article

description_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 July 2026 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI) (Text with EEA relevance)
description_sv: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 July 2026 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI) (Text with EEA relevance)

description_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence and amending Regulations (EC) No 300/2008, (EU) No 167/2013, (EU) No 168/2013, (EU) 2018/858, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2019/2144 and Directives 2014/90/EU, (EU) 2016/797 and (EU) 2020/1828 (Artificial Intelligence Act) (Text with EEA relevance)
description_sv: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence and amending Regulations (EC) No 300/2008, (EU) No 167/2013, (EU) No 168/2013, (EU) 2018/858, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2019/2144 and Directives 2014/90/EU, (EU) 2016/797 and (EU) 2020/1828 (Artificial Intelligence Act) (Text with EEA relevance)

title_en: Amendments to sectoral product law apply
title_sv: Ändringarna i sektoriell produktlagstiftning börjar gälla
description_en: Articles 102 to 110, which amend aviation, vehicle, marine, rail and consumer legislation.
description_sv: Artiklarna 102–110, som ändrar lagstiftning om luftfart, fordon, marin utrustning, järnväg och konsumentskydd.
source_quote: Articles 102 to 110 shall apply from 27 July 2026.

description_en: The rest of the Regulation applies, including the transparency obligations of Article 50 and post-market monitoring, except the parts with later dates.
description_sv: Resten av förordningen börjar gälla, bland annat transparenskraven i artikel 50, utom de delar som har senare datum.

title_en: New prohibitions; marking deadline for existing generators
title_sv: Nya förbud; märkningsfrist för befintliga generatorer
description_en: The prohibitions added in 2026 (Article 5(1), points (ba) and (bb)) apply, and generators placed on the market before 2 August 2026 must comply with Article 50(2).
description_sv: Förbuden som lades till 2026 (artikel 5.1 leden ba och bb) börjar gälla, och generatorer som släppts ut före den 2 augusti 2026 ska uppfylla artikel 50.2.
source_quote: points (ba) and (bb), and Article 5(1a) and (1b) which shall apply from 2 December 2026

title_en: Deadline for general-purpose AI models already on the market
title_sv: Sista dag för AI-modeller för allmänna ändamål som redan fanns på marknaden
description_en: Providers of models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 must comply.
description_sv: Leverantörer av modeller som släpptes ut före den 2 augusti 2025 ska uppfylla kraven.
source_quote: Providers of general-purpose AI models that have been placed on the market before 2 August 2025 shall take the necessary steps in order to comply with the obligations laid down in this Regulation by 2 August 2027.

title_en: High-risk rules apply: Annex III systems
title_sv: Högriskreglerna börjar gälla: system i bilaga III
description_en: Chapter III, Sections 1 to 3, for systems that are high-risk under Article 6(2) and Annex III (employment, education, essential services and more).
description_sv: Kapitel III avsnitt 1–3 för system som är högrisk enligt artikel 6.2 och bilaga III (anställning, utbildning, viktiga tjänster med mera).
source_quote: 2 December 2027 as regards AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(2) and Annex III

title_en: High-risk rules apply: Annex I products
title_sv: Högriskreglerna börjar gälla: produkter i bilaga I
description_en: Chapter III, Sections 1 to 3, for AI systems that are safety components of products under the legislation in Annex I.
description_sv: Kapitel III avsnitt 1–3 för AI-system som är säkerhetskomponenter i produkter enligt lagstiftningen i bilaga I.
source_quote: 2 August 2028 as regards AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(1) and Annex I

title_en: Deadline for high-risk systems used by public authorities
title_sv: Sista dag för högrisksystem som används av myndigheter
description_en: Providers and deployers of high-risk systems intended for public authorities, placed on the market before the high-risk rules applied, must comply.
description_sv: Leverantörer och användare av högrisksystem avsedda för myndigheter, som släppts ut innan högriskreglerna började gälla, ska uppfylla kraven.
source_quote: the providers and deployers of high-risk AI systems intended to be used by public authorities shall take the necessary steps to comply with the requirements and obligations laid down in this Regulation by 2 August 2030.

title_en: Deadline for AI in large-scale EU IT systems
title_sv: Sista dag för AI i EU:s storskaliga IT-system
description_en: AI systems that are components of the large-scale IT systems in Annex X, placed on the market before 2 August 2027, must comply.
description_sv: AI-system som är komponenter i de storskaliga IT-systemen i bilaga X och släpptes ut före den 2 augusti 2027 ska uppfylla kraven.
source_quote: shall be brought into compliance with this Regulation by 31 December 2030.
